_comment: Klondike Solitaire locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. NEVER translate card labels/suits (e.g. A, 10, K, ♣️, ♦️, ♥️, ♠️), the pile tokens W, F1-F4, T1-T7, the ASCII board in {board}, or the commands 'draw', 'move', 'forfeit', 'all'. The bracket syntax like 'move W T1' must stay in Latin as-is.

_slots.{n}: Action index within a comma-separated command, 1-based
_slots.{msg}: A nested per-action result message (already localized)
_slots.{count}: Number of face-up cards being moved
_slots.{cmd}: The unknown command the player typed (not translated)
_slots.{max_turns}: The maximum number of turns before the game ends
_slots.{score}: Number of cards currently in the foundation piles
_slots.{stock}: Number of cards left in the stock
_slots.{waste}: The top waste card label, or '--' if empty (never translate)
_slots.{cards}: The cards in a pile as neutral labels, or '--' if empty (never translate)

player_prompt.intro: Wo re di Klondike Solitaire. W' botae ne sɛ wobɛkɔ akɔfa nkrataa nyinaa aba fapem no so. Agodie mmara: - Nnyinasoɔ piles (F1-F4): Yɛ nea edi kan fi Ace kɔsi King wɔ suita mu - Tableau piles, T1-T7): yɛ a ɛtɔso mmienu firi red to black na afei nso efi tableau pile foforo bi ho; - Stock: Draw cards to waste pile - Waste (W): top card available for play Akwankyerɛ: 'twe' - Twe kaade afiri stock de kɔ gu waste hɔ - 'sesa <nfidie><nhyease> [count]' - Sesa ma afedie fa apon ntam Mfatoho: 'sese W1', 'sesue T1 F2', 'sesɛ T3 T5 2'. Wobɛtumi aka 'all' nso, ɛno nti ɛrenyɛ yiye sɛ wɔbɛsɔ anim-anim krataa biara ntɛm ara. - Fa wo hyɛmu - Di agoru awieeɛ na twe w' din ahorow si ananmu seesei ara - Pile: W (was), F4-F1-T1, twere pii bɛtumi ayɛ adwuma bere a wode nneɛma bebree adi dwuma ama atotow ahwere wɔn ase - Waster (W) A/A = Workout commandments: Sɛ wobetwa sika baako pɛ na ɛda fam kanea yi akyi a, wubetumi asisi nnwuma afa ɔfoforo biako nkutoo denam asabammɔdi akwantuo so te sɛ wubu kwan a ɛwɔ funu mu.

format_error.no_closing_bracket: Akwan a wɔfa so yɛ adwuma no ho nteɛ. Nkyinkyimfo bracket nni hɔ ']'

format_error.move_needs_args: Move command hia source ne destination. Usage: 'move <source> <destination> [count]'
format_error.count_positive: Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔkan no ma ɛyɛ papa anaa "ɛwɔ mu" nyinaa.
format_error.count_invalid: Nnye din. Fa nɔma anaa 'ne nyinaa' di dwuma
